MIDDLESEX COUNTY
SHERIFF'S SALE
25002502
SUPERIOR COURT
OF NEW JERSEY
CHANCERY DIVISION
MIDDLESEX COUNTY
DOCKET NO.
DCO0849720 DJ 1646925
CLEARBROOK ASSOCIATION, is the Plaintiff. and SETH SEVIN, ET ALS., are Defendants. writ of execution for the sale of mortgaged premises dated 08/27/2025,
By virtue of the above stated Writ, to me directed and delivered, I will expose to sale at public vendue on WEDNESDAY, the 19TH DAY of NOVEMBER A.D. 2025, at the hour of one thirty o' clock by the then prevailing (Standard or Daylight Saving) time, in the afternoon of the said day, at the Heldrich Hotel, 10 Livingston Ave, New Brunswick, N.J. 08901.
ALL that certain lot, piece or parcel of land, with the buildings and improvements thereon erected, situate, lying and being in the Municipality of Township of Monroe, in the County of Middlesex. State of NJ:
Known as and designated as Unit No. 2G, Bldg. 277 situated in Clearbrook. a Condominium, Section No. 4. a condominium. established in accordance with the N.J.S.A. 46:8b- 1, et seq., together with an undivided .6460% interest in the General Common elements of said condominium appurtenant to the aforesaid unit in accordance with and subject to the terms, conditions. covenants, restrictions, reservations easements, lien as for assessments, and other provisions as set forth in the current Master Deed of Clearbrook, a Condominium, Section No. 4, dated July 26, 1974, recorded July 29, 1974, in the Office of the Middlesex Clerk in Deed Book 2860, Page 627; amendments, addendums, regulations and resoluti6ns in Deed Book 2867, Page 418; Deed Book 2896, Page 643; Deed Book 3134, Page 836; Deed Book 3726, Page 598; Deed Book 3779, Page 520; Deed Book 3779, Page 524; Deed Book 3782, Page 406; Deed Book 4005, Page 308; Deed Book 4033, Page 50; Deed Book 4167, Page 45; Deed Book 4576, Page 528; Deed Book 4854, Page 587; Deed Book 5067, Page 514; Deed Book 5340, Page 877; Deed Book 5678, Page 858;
Deed Book 5852, Page 292; Deed Book 5880, Page 391 ; Deed Book 6277, Page 322; Deed Book 6648, Page 801 ; Deed Book 6648, Page 806; Deed Book 6648, Page 812; Deed Book 6648, Page 821 ; and Deed Book 6676, Page 356, as same may now or hereafter be further lawfully amended
The above description being drawn in accordance with a survey certificate prepared by William Held Associates. Inc., Jack L. Held, N.J.P.L.S., dated August 12, 2016. FOR INFORMATION
PURPOSES ONLY:
Premises: 277-2G Crosse Drive, Township of Monroe, Middlesex County, NJ 08831 Block: 26 Lot: 34.1 (]ual.: C002G
SURPLUS MONEY: if after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
The approximate amount of the upset to be satisfied by said sale is the sum of TWENTY THOUSAND FOUR HUNDRED FORTY DOLLARS AND SEVEN CENTS ($20,440.07) dollars more or less, plus interest together with the costs of this sale. THE UPSET AMOUNT MAY BE SUBJECT TO FURTHER ORDERS OF ADDITIONAL SUMS.
The subscriber reserves the right to adjourn said sale from time to time subject only to such limitations or restrictions upon the exercise of such power as may be specially provided by law or rules of the Court. Sold subject to conditions of sale.
Successful bidder must pay 20% of bid in a certlfied check or official bank check at close of sale and the balance in two weeks.
Mildred S. Scott, Sheriff Attorney :
BECKER NEW YORK. P.C.
1776 ON THE GREEN
67 EAST PARK PLACE, SUITE 800 MORRISTOWN. NJ 07960
